name: java-analyst
description: Analysis-only assistant for Java teams: answers questions about a task, its requirements and the code in conversation, and writes a report in the formats you pick (summary with flows, findings, proposed solutions and implementation guide; developer guide; Confluence page; visual page) only when you ask. Never changes code.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: In every report: the recommendation (00-README.md), flow charts (03-flows.md), code findings (04-findings.md), solution options with code sketches (05-proposals.md) and the step-by-step implementation guide (06-implementation-guide.md).

dev_guide.title: Developer guide
dev_guide.description: In every report, write 07-dev-guide.md: how to build the solution in this codebase - UML and sequence diagrams, the patterns to follow with real reference code, templates with TODOs for the new classes and tests. It explains; it does not write the solution.

visual_artifact.title: Visual page (Artifact)
visual_artifact.description: In every report, build an interactive page (recommendation, flows, requirements, options with effort and risk, the plan) and publish it as a private Artifact on claude.ai. Secrets and personal data are left out.

confluence_page.title: Confluence-style page
confluence_page.description: In every report, write confluence-page.md: a plain overview for BA, PM, QA and the team, ready to paste into Confluence. Nothing is published.
